verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. The record pointed at the Government of Iceland's news item of 1 July 2025 announcing the English edition, an announcement; the plan's own text is published in the government library in English and in Icelandic. Stored in this run as the plan's text: the English edition (40 pages), which carries the ministry's imprint, 'July 2025' and its own ISBN, and becomes the official URL; and the Icelandic edition (32 pages), which gives the Icelandic title, 'Júlí 2025' and a separate ISBN, and becomes the secondary URL. Neither edition gives a day, so date_published now has the month the plan gives, and the notes keep the days of the two news items (1 July 2025 for the English edition, 2 July 2025 for the Icelandic one, read in an earlier run). Re-read the English news item of 1 July 2025 (stored 11 Oct 2026). The English edition does not call itself a translation and is recorded as one of the issuer's own texts.
